ownership.summary: CRAFTSMAN is a Stanley Black & Decker brand. The group's and CRAFTSMAN's own materials position it alongside DEWALT and BLACK+DECKER rather than as a separate parent company.

productPortfolio.name: V20 cordless system
productPortfolio.positioning: A 20V MAX consumer and prosumer platform spanning drilling, cutting, fastening and outdoor use.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm the exact battery generation, charger, bare-tool or kit pack and local compatibility.

productPortfolio.name: Hand tools, storage and workshop equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: CRAFTSMAN combines power tools with hand tools, storage and worksite accessories.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Seller, warranty and replacement-part terms can differ by product family.

productPortfolio.name: Outdoor power equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: The brand includes homeowner outdoor equipment alongside core tool categories.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify safety documents, battery configuration and local service coverage for each outdoor model.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: CRAFTSMAN's reviewed material identifies a brand and platform offer, not a single factory map for all tools and outdoor products.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Require an exact SKU label, declaration and factory/origin evidence before contracting.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Stanley Black & Decker is the group-level brand owner, while CRAFTSMAN warranty coverage is controlled by product and authorized-sales conditions.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Group ownership and U.S. warranty terms
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Separate trademark ownership from the named seller, importer, manufacturer and guarantor.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: CRAFTSMAN's support route separates product help, parts, service and warranty resources.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm the service route for the exact product family and country.

marketsChannels.evidence: CRAFTSMAN's 2026 battery release identifies participating Lowe's and Ace Hardware channels for the named launch.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm current authorized availability for the target retailer and model.

marketsChannels.evidence: CRAFTSMAN warranty terms require purchase through CRAFTSMAN.com or an authorized retailer for the stated coverage.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Retain dated proof of purchase and verify seller authorization before ordering.

marketsChannels.evidence: The official support page provides product, parts, warranty and service routes.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the appropriate local support route rather than relying on a reseller statement.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: CRAFTSMAN offers a broad homeowner and workshop proposition built around V20, hand tools and storage. Its buyer-side challenge is not brand recognition but accountability: the exact product, retailer and warranty terms should be verified independently of Stanley Black & Decker group ownership.
